ValidationRule.description: Prevents a Builder Division from being set Active without an active pricing book. Work Orders cannot be priced without it. Deployed inactive; activate after sandbox T12 passes. Spec VR 7.5.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Account_Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Account_Status__c, "Active"), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Builder_Market", Pricing_Book_Active__c = false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Activate the BMG pricing book before setting this division Active. Work Orders cannot be priced without it.
